verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API supports pushing transactions in (upload transactions, createOrder). It also offers connectors for Amazon FBA, BigCommerce, eBay, Magento 2, NetSuite, PayPal, Shopify, Square, Stripe and WooCommerce, and is positioned for businesses selling through multiple platforms. AutoFile then builds returns from the consolidated state report, so filings cover every channel. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of historical/backfill imports via API or connectors, details on deduplication and merging across channels, independent hands-on corroboration, and clarity on the 10-integration cap shown on the pricing tier.
